def check_graph(edges, n=8):

    # Check chromatic number

    chi = max(coloring.values()) + 1

        return False, f"Chromatic number {chi} not in [2,3]"
    
    return True, f"Valid! edges={num_edges}, min_deg={min_deg}, max_deg={max_deg}, chi={chi}"

def is_k_colorable(G, n, k):
    colors = [-1] * n
    def backtrack(v):
        if v == n:
            return True
        for c in range(k):
            if all(colors[u] != c for u in G.neighbors(v)):
                colors[v] = c
                if backtrack(v + 1):
                    return True
                colors[v] = -1
        return False
    return backtrack(0)
